summary: Ascentage Pharma Group International filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing its upcoming data presentations at the 2026 ASCO Annual Meeting. The filing is a routine report of scientific conference participation, disclosing six abstracts from studies of three drug candidates (Olverembatinib, Lisaftoclax, Alrizomadlin) selected for presentations. No corporate transactions, strategic changes, or special situations are involved. This is a standard disclosure by a foreign private issuer of scientific/medical meeting activity with no deal terms, board actions, or structural changes.
